question: What qualification must a recipient meet before the teaching may be given to one who has previously accomplished it?
premises: The teaching is only to be given to a qualified recipient.
Prior accomplishment alone does not suffice for immediate transmission.
A test lasting one year is required to establish qualification.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished who has been tested for a full year.
uncertainties: Nature of the one-year test remains unspecified
plain_english: It is to be given only to one who has previously accomplished it and has been tested for one year.
